21.L210:
<n>3:57</n> Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
<n>3:58</n> Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
<n>3:59</n> Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
<n>3:60</n> Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
<n>3:61</n> Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
<n>3:62</n> Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
<n>3:63</n> Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
<n>3:64</n> Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
<n>3:65</n> Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
<n>3:66</n> Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
<n>3:67</n> Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
<n>3:68</n> Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
<n>3:69</n> Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
<n>3:70</n> Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
<n>3:71</n> Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
<n>3:72</n> Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
<n>3:73</n> Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ justórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
<n>3:74</n> Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
<n>3:75</n> Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
<n>3:56</n> Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
21.E210:
<n>3:57</n> All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.
<n>3:58</n> O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:
<n>3:59</n> O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.
<n>3:60</n> O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.
<n>3:61</n> O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.
<n>3:62</n> O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.
<n>3:63</n> O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.
<n>3:64</n> O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.
<n>3:65</n> O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.
<n>3:66</n> O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.
<n>3:67</n> O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.
<n>3:68</n> O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.
<n>3:69</n> O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.
<n>3:70</n> O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.
<n>3:71</n> O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.
<n>3:72</n> O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.
<n>3:73</n> O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.
<n>3:74</n> O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.
<n>3:75</n> Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.
<n>3:56</n> Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.
